lessons.key: surviving_mutant::when a facade method backs up before a write for ad 011 safety add a call order test spy monkeypatch recording invocation order not just a post hoc existence check on the backup file
lessons.text: When a facade method backs up before a write for AD-011 safety, add a call-order test (spy/monkeypatch recording invocation order), not just a post-hoc existence check on the backup file.

lessons.key: ac_gap::when an ac names two branches explicit choice vs default preference fallback write a passing case test for each branch not just the fallback success case and the explicit choice failure case
lessons.text: When an AC names two branches (explicit choice vs. default-preference fallback), write a passing-case test for each branch, not just the fallback success case and the explicit-choice failure case.

lessons.key: ac_gap::a spec claim of lock independence for a read path needs a test that actually holds a lock during the read not just reuse of a mode ro connection pattern already used elsewhere
lessons.text: A spec claim of lock-independence for a read path needs a test that actually holds a lock during the read, not just reuse of a mode=ro connection pattern already used elsewhere.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::when a framework already wraps all handler exceptions into a generic error type test the app level exception mapper directly unit level bypassing the framework rather than relying on an end to end assertion that the framework s catch all can satisfy on its own
lessons.text: When a framework already wraps all handler exceptions into a generic error type, test the app-level exception mapper directly (unit-level, bypassing the framework) rather than relying on an end-to-end assertion that the framework's catch-all can satisfy on its own.

lessons.key: ac_gap::cover every spec edge case with an assertion on the specific value or multiplicity it calls out not just a key presence or single instance check that would pass even if the edge case logic were removed
lessons.text: Cover every spec Edge Case with an assertion on the specific value or multiplicity it calls out, not just a key-presence or single-instance check that would pass even if the edge-case logic were removed.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::before extracting a shared side effecting core check existing tests for assertions on side effect order e g no backup on a failed convert stricter than the spec ac reusing one core across callers can force a new ordering reconcile against the ac and get sign off before editing the over specified assertion
lessons.text: Before extracting a shared side-effecting core, check existing tests for assertions on side-effect ORDER (e.g. 'no backup on a failed convert') stricter than the spec AC — reusing one core across callers can force a new ordering; reconcile against the AC and get sign-off before editing the over-specified assertion.
